covariance.description: 72 U U^T + 0.02 I; U is the first 50 coordinate basis vectors

jackknife.method: delete one group, recompute entire statistic with retained split order

interpretations.within_3SE_on_average: Across the 200 independent replicates, absolute mean estimator error <= 3 times its Monte Carlo standard error (sample SD / sqrt(200)).
interpretations.cosine_reference: For each replicate, cosine of its full-batch sample mean with the known mean; compare mean split-half reliability with mean realized cosine.
interpretations.effective_rank_reference: trace(Sigma)^2 / trace(Sigma^2), using the approved four-distinct-group, mean-free denominator estimator.
interpretations.coverage_scope: Signal and covariance trace coverage are formal gate criteria. Other interval coverages are explicitly descriptive; cosine coverage uses a random realized reference, not a fixed population parameter.
interpretations.undefined: Retain signed estimates. Do not clip, epsilon-adjust, discard undefined jackknife replicates, or tune the design after results. Any undefined required metric fails the gate.
interpretations.odd_jackknife_split: Keep each original random group ordering, remove the deleted group, and split the retained ordering into floor(G/2) and ceil(G/2) groups. Recompute the same specified cosine transform; record the unequal deletion halves.
